reason: User selected A0+A2+A3, two training seeds per arm, in three separately started sessions due to machine time constraints.
session_launch: Each session requires its own explicit launch; no automatic next session. New seeds within a session run sequentially.
interruptions: Pause only between completed seeds. Failed or interrupted seeds are spent and cannot be resumed.

inference.interpretation: Exploratory component ablation with two training seeds per arm; limited estimation of between-training-seed variability. Environment-seed sign-flip inference is conditional on these trained checkpoints.

evaluation_panel_note: 657201-657220 remain shared evaluation seeds outside training. Their A0-parent and baseline outcomes were already observed; they are not a newly sealed or unseen qualification panel.
formal_implementation_note: Before formal runs, A0 initialization is corrected to exactly match the original security-v4 parent under the same Torch seed; ablation act uses the parent's six-output decoder. Earlier pilot receipts are preserved as implementation/throughput checks for their recorded source versions.
